title: Adversarial ML Lab evaluation run provenance (v1)
description: Frozen contract for an evaluation run's provenance metadata block. Every run result includes a provenance block capturing dataset identity, runtime configuration, code version, and metric definitions. Malformed provenance blocks MUST fail closed.

contract_id.description: Immutable contract identifier for run provenance. Must be 'adml.evaluation.run.v1'.

dataset_filename.description: Filename of the dataset used for this run (no absolute path).

suite_name.description: Suite name reported in evaluation results.

content_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the dataset file bytes at run time.

case_count.description: Number of cases in the dataset, or null when no manifest was available.

contract_id.description: Dataset contract identifier from the resolved manifest, or null when no manifest was available.

packaged_resource.description: Packaged resource path from the manifest, or null when no manifest was available.

llm_mode.description: LLM mode used for the run (e.g. 'simulation', 'openai', 'anthropic', 'ollama').

simulation_seed.description: Placeholder for future simulation seed support. Always null in v1.

deterministic.description: True when the run uses simulation mode and is fully deterministic.

package_version.description: Semantic version of the adversarial-ml-lab package at run time.

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA for a source-tree run, or null when no repository metadata is available (for example, an installed wheel).

config_fingerprint_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical (sorted-key, compact) default defense/LLM configuration.

definitions.description: Immutable metric definitions documenting every metric name and its meaning.
